name: Life Spiritual
overview: The spiritual life begins with the new birth, a transformation that Jesus describes as being born of water and the Spirit, essential to entering the kingdom of God (John 3:3-5). This new birth marks the origin of a life hidden with Christ and led by the Spirit, characterized by a profound change from flesh to spirit (John 3:6-8). Such a life grows from infancy through youth to maturity, evidenced by love for the brethren and a living faith, all sustained and authored by God through Christ.
